energy_drink.name: Slag Cola
energy_drink.blurb: Tastes like a battery. Works like one too.

lockpick.name: Lockpick Set
lockpick.blurb: Opens doors that forgot to be locked properly.

ledger_page.name: Ledger Page
ledger_page.blurb: A torn page from Crowe's books. Every page is a name.

favor_token.name: Favor Token
favor_token.blurb: Cinder City runs on these. So do you, now.

att_suppressor.name: Suppressor
att_suppressor.blurb: Quiets the report — shots raise no gunfire alarm. Slight damage loss.

att_extmag.name: Extended Mag
att_extmag.blurb: +8 rounds per magazine. Reload a touch slower.

att_grip.name: Foregrip
att_grip.blurb: Tames the climb pattern — sustained fire stays on target.

att_scope.name: Scope x4
att_scope.blurb: Half spread while aimed; the bolt cycles slower.

att_laser.name: Laser Sight
att_laser.blurb: Tight hip-fire cone. Paints your intent for anyone watching.

att_hotload.name: Hot Load
att_hotload.blurb: Hand-loaded rounds hit harder and kick harder.
